verdict.rationale: The vendor docs say the conversion API turns PDFs into Markdown, HTML, JSON or chunks and that Marker "handles complex layouts, tables, math, and images," with an accurate mode available. Hands-on community reports are mixed: one user found it did a great job on a technical book, another found it intermingled columns in tricky multi-column cases, and a third found tables and text boxes in an RPG rulebook messed up. Missing for 10: any documentation or evidence on header/footer removal, footnote handling, and reading-order guarantees; independent benchmarks of multi-column accuracy; and evidence that the column-ordering failures have been fixed (the community reports concern the open-source Marker, not necessarily the hosted API).
